dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Since we're having a break, how about we enjoy some sweet treats?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: If you want my recommendation, I'd say lemon cheesecake is the perfect choice for this occasion! Unlike Macarons, it has a tartness to it as well as the sweetness, which excites the tastebuds and keeps you awake and alert.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: That way, we won't fall asleep reading!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: We'll have to break out the big guns if we wanna show those domain-dwellers who's boss.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: ...Heh, that didn't sound so different from something I might say in a Spina meeting.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I guess it's the same job, at the end of the day: Getting thugs and bullies to eat some humble pie. It's the only way they'll ever learn some manners.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I'm assuming that the books here aren't for lending out...?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: In that case, I guess I'll have to read as much as I can while I'm here and take detailed notes on the best stories. I'm sure the children of Poisson would love to hear them.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Also... I noticed that some of the "fairy tales" here really aren't suitable for children at all... Makes me curious what sort of quirky person could've written them, haha.
